summary: A first run for the state legislature ended in a loss, eighth among thirteen candidates.
realLife: In August 1832 Lincoln ran as a Whig for the Illinois General Assembly and was defeated, finishing eighth in a field of thirteen candidates.
sources: National Park Service, Lincoln Chronology, Lincoln Home National Historic Site: https://www.nps.gov/liho/learn/historyculture/lincolnchronology.htm
